title: Uncle Taton Bonds and his string band
summary: His uncle played with bass, guitar, mandolin and violin, mostly by ear, with no trumpets, at parties and serenades; Barnes was a small child when he died.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth
